findings.description: M87 AC-04 requires Tab from Overview content to focus the sidebar (handle_overview_lane_key → ToggleSidebar). M91 removes the sidebar and makes Tab toggle tab bar ↔ content (M91 AC-04). Implementing M87 S4 now writes tests and behavior that M91 must immediately rip out. Defer Overview/focus-key work to M91; drop or park AC-04 and S4 from M87.
findings.resolution: Removed AC-04; S4 skipped and deferred to M91
findings.title: AC-04/S4 conflicts with M91 tab-bar focus model

findings.description: Code already routes Overview Up/Down/f/Esc via map_overview_key → PassToEventHandler (M89). The audit complaint about handle_status_lane_key swallowing arrows is largely addressed. Remaining gap is Tab→sidebar, which M91 supersedes — not a standalone M87 deliverable.
findings.resolution: AC-04 removed; Overview routing addressed by M89; Tab focus owned by M91
findings.title: AC-04 problem partly stale post-M89

findings.description: S4 tests live in crates/raul/tests/tui_sidebar.rs — the file M91 explicitly migrates to tui_tab_bar.rs. Doing S4 in M87 creates throwaway test churn before the layout milestone.
findings.resolution: S4 skipped; no throwaway tui_sidebar implementation in M87
findings.title: S4 test target tui_sidebar.rs will be rewritten by M91

findings.description: Drill-in/hide_done, panic visibility, truncation, co-approval approve tolerance, and tracks [kind] prefix are layout-agnostic. M91 depends_on 87 and lists these as out-of-scope — keep them in M87 and ship before M91.
findings.resolution: Confirmed S1-S3,S5-S6 remain in M87 before M91
findings.title: S1–S3,S5–S6 remain valid — ship in M87 before M91
